description: Remove a custom domain from the profile: it stops showing the publication and its slot is free at once. The BrewPage link keeps working. Addressed by publication (type, namespace, id; an owner token in the profile) or by hostname (an admin token of the profile). DNS records at the provider stay until the domain owner deletes them.

hostname.description: Custom domain, e.g. www.example.com; instead of type, namespace and id

ownerToken.description: By publication: an owner token in the profile. By hostname: an admin token of the profile. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only).

type.description: Publication type; with namespace and id, instead of hostname

name: remove_domain
title: Remove custom domain
